b: Long story short, I've been a good tenant and on time with my rent for 12 years. This year has been the most emotionally draining time of my life, and I've dealt with a lot of things that played into a couple jobs being lost and getting behind on rent.

My landlord has been patient and gracious but he's fed up, understandably so. He's going to the court tomorrow or Monday and then the 24 day window starts. I won't be able to come up with what I owe, it's a substantial amount of money that I can't get.
My question is, at 33 years old, is this the end? Realistically, will I be able to find a place in the future that isn't in the slums or leases out by a predatory landlord?
Any advice or comments are welcome. I'm feeling so low.
